goal: Implement a standard-library Python module named log_summary.py with summarize_log(text). Each nonblank input line must be LEVEL: message where LEVEL is INFO, WARN, or ERROR. Return a dictionary with total_lines and counts keyed by all three levels. Ignore blank lines. Raise ValueError for malformed lines or unknown levels, and include the one-based line number in the error message.
constraints: Keep the implementation in log_summary.py and use only the Python standard library.
Do not change the checker or problem definition; submit a Contribution containing the complete implementation.
acceptance_criterion: The configured checker passes all valid-input, blank-line, count, unknown-level, and malformed-line cases against the integrated Candidate.
